Enabled.Name: Enable exploration WASD lock
Enabled.Hint: When enabled, players cannot drag/click-move tokens outside combat; use WASD or arrow keys instead.

AllowInCombat.Name: Lift restriction in combat
AllowInCombat.Hint: Once combat has started, players may move tokens with the mouse again. Restriction returns when combat ends.

NotifyBlocked.Name: Notify when drag is blocked
NotifyBlocked.Hint: Show a notification if a player tries to drag a token while restricted.

ShowHint.Name: Show corner hint
ShowHint.Hint: Show a small on-screen reminder while the WASD lock is active.

StepDiagonals.Name: Allow diagonals (chords)
StepDiagonals.Hint: Holding two directions (e.g. W+D) moves one diagonal step.

Notify.Blocked: Outside combat, move with WASD / arrow keys. Mouse dragging unlocks when combat starts.
